chunks: Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī al-Ḥalabī asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام:
about a man who has only one garment, and in it there is urine, and he is unable to wash it. He said: “He prays in it.”

key_terms.الثَّوْبُ: the garment or clothing worn for prayer
key_terms.بَوْلٌ: urine, a source of ritual impurity
key_terms.فِيهِ: in it, meaning in that same garment

ai.seo_question: What should a person do if his only garment is impure with urine and he cannot wash it before prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling for one who possesses only a single garment that has urine on it and is unable to wash it. Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام states that he should perform salat in that garment, indicating the ruling of necessity in a case of incapacity.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.752 - Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Halabi asked Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as)

about a man who has only one garment, and it has urine on it, but he is unable to wash it.
Imam (as) said: "He should pray in it."
